$comment: Contract between phonegw (Python, jsonschema) and the app (:protocol, kotlinx-serialization). Every frame = envelope.json with body = the schema below for (direction, t). Fixtures: fixtures/valid/<dir>.<t>[.<case>].json must validate; fixtures/invalid/<dir>.<t>.<case>.json must be rejected. hello and config are connection state: the gateway sends them directly on every WebSocket connect with ack false (not through the outbox), so they are not in ack_required. Privacy: no lat, lon, coords, ssid, bssid, mac, text or title key may appear in any c2s state/event schema.

voice.query: call_id (optional: an answered call.ring) | resume=<v_ id>&gap_ms=N (re-attach a call whose connection dropped; any route, same device)
voice.up: binary PCM16 LE mono 16 kHz, <= 64000 bytes per frame; text {"type":"hangup"}
voice.down: binary PCM16 LE mono 24 kHz; text JSON type state|transcript|turn|status|metric|error|flush|hangup
voice.flush: stop playback and drop queued audio (barge-in)
voice.resume: gateway frames: {type:resume, id, grace_s} first (the call's id), {type:resumed, id, gap_ms} on a resume; a dropped connection is held grace_s (the relay hears link lost/back), buffered mic audio goes up after resumed

close_codes.4408: stalled: no audio up for a few seconds (resume)
close_codes.4409: replaced by a resume on another socket
close_codes.4410: resume refused: the call has ended

trackid.body: raw audio (audio/mp4, audio/aac, audio/ogg, audio/wav, audio/webm), 1-20 s, <= 2 MiB

trip.sites: GET /v1/trip/sites (http.trip.sites.response, ETag; the dive quick-log's site chips, dive count and the last dive day before flying)
trip.saver: roaming or a foreign network country: keepalive 540 s, uploads <= 100 KB, photos wait for Wi-Fi

rules.nfc: event nfc.tag = the NDEF URI id of claudeapp://tag/<id>, or 'h' + 15 hex of sha256('claude-nfc:' + UID hex) for a blank tag; the UID never leaves the phone
rules.health: health.daily only when the gateway config health is true AND the app switch is on; the gateway drops it otherwise
rules.open: s2c open goes out only on a live socket (not queued, ack false) and is answered by c2s open.result (ack false) within the gateway's wait; no answer = a stale socket: the gateway closes it and the caller falls back (Telegram URL button). The app never opens after until (clock skew allowance 0).
